statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of four representative archetypes. Explicitly not covered: authenticated account settings, payment/subscription completion, content upload, live chat, and actual video playback because they require credentials, payment, or extended media interaction.

page.notes: Requested host redirects to https://hil.xhamster46.desi/. Public adult media site localized as HIL.

paths.description: Homepage listing and primary discovery surface; represents global navigation, consent, age verification and content feed.
Search-results listing for the primary find-content journey.
Sign-in form and empty-submit recovery path.

findings.summary: The fixed dark palette does not follow the system color-scheme preference
findings.evidence: Dark and default screenshots are visually identical, and the CSS probe found no color-scheme preference support.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply dark-mode guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Animations continue when reduced motion is requested
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found eight running 2000 ms animations while prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matched, and no reduced-motion CSS was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply accessibility guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Key text fails contrast requirements and no contrast preference styling exists
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured contrast ratios of 1.75:1 and 2.15:1 in the age banner plus 3.29:1 for view counts; the CSS probe found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply adapt-scrollbar-to-contrast-preferences guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no view-transition rules on an MPA with search, login, listing and detail routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply cross-document-transitions guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Long listing pages provide no scroll-state feedback
findings.evidence: The desktop and mobile captures show a long feed with static chrome, while the CSS probe found no scroll-state or scroll-timeline implementation.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply scroll-progress-indicator guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Navigation changes offer no directional or destination cue
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no View Transition, scroll marker or highlight implementation across the tested listing, search and detail routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply directional-navigation-transitions guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: A cookie interstitial obscures the primary content on load
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots of home, search and detail routes show a large centered cookie overlay covering the main content before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply light-dismiss-a-dialog guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: The consent overlay is not exposed as a dialog
findings.evidence: The overlay is visible in screenshots, but the DOM probe reported zero dialog elements and zero role=dialog elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply declarative-dialog-popover-control guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Navigation, banners, sidebars, promos and overlays crowd the content
findings.evidence: The first desktop viewport contains two navigation bars, an age banner, a sidebar, a cookie interstitial and promotional cards around the feed.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply defer-rendering-heavy-content guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: The mobile page renders a desktop-width layout and overflows by 672 px
findings.evidence: At a 360 px viewport, layout measured scrollWidth 1032 px and horizontalOverflowPx 672; the screenshot shows most content clipped off-screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply fluid-scaling guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt to their available container
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no container queries, and the 360 px capture retains the desktop sidebar and content grid.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply size-aware-styling guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated
findings.evidence: The active search button computed to outline none 0px and box-shadow none.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply accessibility guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Viewing content requires multiple overlapping gates
findings.evidence: The detail route presents age verification plus the cookie overlay before the player can be reached, adding avoidable modal detours to the primary viewing journey.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply declarative-dialog-popover-control guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Invalid sign-in and missing-page states do not provide useful recovery
findings.evidence: Submitting the empty sign-in form produced no invalid controls and no alert or live-region message; /sitemap.xml produced a generic browser 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply accessible-error-announcement guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP is outside the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.9 s and FCP 2.8 s; the trace measured LCP 2285 ms under a separate desktop run.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply performance guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: The load has a large request graph and render-blocking styles
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 144 requests and 1.76 MB transferred, including three parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority stylesheets and a redirect.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply optimize-preload-priority guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable unused CSS and JavaScript
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 56 KiB unused CSS with 90 to 95 percent waste in two files, plus 26 KiB unused JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply identify-heavy-scripts guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: An interactive button has no accessible name
findings.evidence: Lighthouse identified a visible 40 by 24 button with no text, aria-label, title or label. The username field also lacks a programmatic label.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply accessibility guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Text and controls have insufficient color contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the color-contrast audit with ratios as low as 1.75:1 on the age banner and 3.29:1 on metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply accessibility guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Focus is invisible on a primary control
findings.evidence: The focused search button had no outline and no box shadow, preventing keyboard users from seeing focus position.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply accessibility guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Mobile clipping prevents comfortable reading
findings.evidence: The 360 px screenshot and layout evidence show a 1032 px content canvas clipped into a narrow strip, cutting headings and cards.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply improve-text-layout-and-legibility guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: The experience does not reflow at a narrow mobile width
findings.evidence: The viewport allows scaling, but at 360 px the page overflows horizontally by 672 px and leaves content unreachable without two-dimensional scrolling.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply fluid-scaling guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Most images do not reserve layout space and many are oversized
findings.evidence: The image audit found 29 of 36 images missing width or height and 13 images more than twice their displayed size.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply optimize-image-priority guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are inconsistent across hosts
findings.evidence: The request redirects from xhamster45 to xhamster46, while canonical points to hil.xhamster.desi; hreflang is absent and /sitemap.xml returns 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply html guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: The public listing lacks structured and social metadata
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found zero JSON-LD blocks and no Open Graph properties despite the page representing a rich media listing.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply html guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: The CSP does not protect script sources and key headers are absent
findings.evidence: HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP only sets frame-ancestors; X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy are missing.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply security guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: The initial load has an extensive third-party data surface
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 15 third-party origins; HAR attributed 142 of 144 requests and 1.757 MB of 1.758 MB to origins different from the requested host, including an ad request.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply privacy guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Sign-in is password-only and does not expose passkeys
findings.evidence: The login probe found username/password and Google/X sign-in but no WebAuthn or passkey integration; the password field is tagged new-password on a sign-in form.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply passkey-authentication guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers show clickjacking protection and HSTS, but missing nosniff and Referrer-Policy plus a frame-only CSP leave XSS and referrer defenses incomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply security guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Custom overlays are fragile across viewports
findings.evidence: The non-semantic cookie overlay covers primary content on desktop, while the mobile viewport clips the page to a 1032 px desktop canvas.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply resilient-context-menus-and-nested-dropdowns guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Missing resources fall through to a generic browser error
findings.evidence: The sitemap request returned HTTP 404 and a chrome-error page with no site navigation or recovery path.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply persistent-toast-notifications guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: The declared language does not match the rendered locale
findings.evidence: The page declares lang=hil, the BCP 47 code for Hiligaynon, while navigation and content are Hindi transliterated into Latin script; no hreflang alternatives are exposed.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply translator guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Compact numbers are not locale-aware
findings.evidence: View counts use fixed English-style compact notation such as 4.2M and 28.8M on the Hindi-localized page, rather than locale-aware formatting.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply support-global-calendar-systems guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: The sign-in form provides no actionable empty-submit feedback
findings.evidence: Both sign-in fields are not required; submitting empty produced no :invalid field and no alert or live-region error.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply accessible-error-announcement guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Sign-in autofill metadata is partly incorrect
findings.evidence: Username uses autocomplete=username, but the sign-in password uses autocomplete=new-password instead of current-password; username has no programmatic label.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply autofill-sign-in-form guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Account authentication lacks a phishing-resistant option
findings.evidence: The tested account entry offers password and federated sign-in only; no passkey/WebAuthn support was detected.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply passkey-authentication guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes
findings.evidence: The image audit found 13 oversized images, 15 legacy-format images, 29 missing dimensions and 8 below-fold images without lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply optimize-image-priority guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: The page starts a large script and third-party workload before user intent
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 62 scripts totaling 1.02 MB and 144 total requests, while Lighthouse found substantial unused CSS and JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply deprioritize-background-fetches guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

findings.summary: Third-party resources dominate the initial page budget
findings.evidence: HAR reports 1.757 MB third-party transfer out of 1.758 MB total and 142 third-party requests, with advertising and federated identity loaded immediately.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply efficient-background-processing guidance to address this evidence, then re-test under the same path and condition.

taskList.title: Repair mobile reflow and component adaptation
Make consent and age gates semantic, non-obscuring and resilient
Fix accessible names, contrast and keyboard focus
Strengthen CSP and privacy headers, then minimize third parties
Correct sign-in validation, labels, autocomplete and add passkeys
Reduce request, script, CSS and image cost
Align canonical, hreflang, sitemap and rich metadata
Add directional and scroll-state navigation cues
